title: Increase Relief on the Lease Term Agreement Renewal Increase Cap
content:
A resident whose rent rose steeply during the expiring Lease Term Agreement receives relief on the next like-program renewal offer line. The increase-relief cap reduction is set by the last rent change recorded on the expiring term, measured as its new rent less its previous rent, divided by its previous rent: an increase of 6 percent or more reduces the cap by 0.75 percentage points; an increase of 3 percent or more but under 6 percent reduces it by 0.25 percentage points; an increase under 3 percent, or a term with no rent change recorded, receives no relief reduction. The cap reduced is the company cap, the expiring term program's renewal increase cap. The reduction never takes the company cap below zero.

## Reading the record

- The rent change read is the rent change record on the expiring term with the latest effective date.
- Its increase is the new rent less the previous rent, divided by the previous rent, unrounded.
- A term with no rent change record receives no relief reduction.

## Bands

| Increase of the last rent change | Relief reduction of the company cap |
|---|---|
| 6 percent (0.06) or more | 0.75 percentage points (0.0075) |
| 3 percent (0.03) or more, under 6 percent | 0.25 percentage points (0.0025) |
| under 3 percent | none |
| no rent change recorded on the term | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical rents)

| Previous rent | New rent | Increase | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2,000.00 | 2,120.00 | exactly 6 percent | 0.75 percentage points |
| 2,000.00 | 2,119.00 | 5.95 percent | 0.25 percentage points |
| 2,000.00 | 2,060.00 | exactly 3 percent | 0.25 percentage points |
| 2,000.00 | 2,059.00 | 2.95 percent | none |
| 2,000.00 | 1,950.00 | a decrease | none |
